name: gstack-execution
description: v0.22.0: the execution-economy objective (XE-001..009) and the evidence items that carry it. The E2E gate proves it can run before anything is pushed (preflight, endform_workflow.py). Capability grants name what they permit, not who may act. Tool order is connector, then CLI, then REST, then browser, with tool_rung.py answering 'is there a connector for this?' by looking rather than by eyeballing a tool list. Cross-tool review is batched per checkpoint and dispatched rather than blocked on. Reviewer routing is a table of {family, model, floor}: a reviewer sharing the builder's model family is refused before it runs, a fallback is recorded as one, and a truncated or empty response is distinguishable from a malformed one. The repository runs its own checks on every pull request, and a run discovering zero checks fails rather than passing. A reviewer receives the diff, the files it changes and the code that references them -- not the repository tree -- which took a review that had been timing out down to 67 seconds, and the surface names the callers the change did not touch. review_host.sh stands up a shell where a dispatched review survives between calls. A round records which files the reviewer opened, how many it was offered, and whether it looked beyond the diff; a filesystem that cannot report reads says so rather than reporting a review that examined nothing. Peer-review records must be written to a declared durable directory: the old default wrote them to a session-local home, so review IDs cited as evidence resolved to nothing.
